tools.name: add-event
tools.description: Add a calendar event to the calendar. Unless specified otherwise in the task, the default week starts on Monday and ends on Sunday.

start_datetime.description: Start datetime in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

end_datetime.description: End datetime in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

tag.description: Tag of the event. Defaults to None.

description.description: Description of the event. Defaults to None.

location.description: Location of the event. Defaults to None.

attendees.description: JSON list of attendees full names, e.g. '["Alice", "Bob"]'.

tools.name: get-event
tools.description: Read a calendar event from the calendar.

event_id.description: Id of the event to read.

tools.name: delete-event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event from the calendar.

event_id.description: Id of the event to delete.

tools.name: get-events
tools.description: Get calendar events that have any time overlap with the specified date range (excludes events that only touch at boundaries). Unless specified otherwise in the task, the default week starts on Monday and ends on Sunday.

start_date.description: Start datetime of the range in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

end_date.description: End datetime of the range in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

offset.description: Offset to start listing from, default is 0.

limit.description: Number of events to list, default is 10.

tools.name: today-events
tools.description: Read today's calendar events from the calendar.

tools.name: get-all-tags
tools.description: Get all tags from the calendar.

tools.name: get-events-by-tag
tools.description: Get calendar events from the calendar by tag.

tag.description: Tag for which to get the events.

tools.name: search-events
tools.description: Searches for calendar events based on a query string. The search looks for partial matches in title, description, location, and attendees.

tools.name: get-contacts
tools.description: Gets the list of contacts starting from a specified offset. There is a view limit. Use offset to scroll through the contacts.

offset.description: Starting point to retrieve contacts from, default is 0.

tools.name: get-contact
tools.description: Gets a specific contact by contact_id.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to retrieve.

tools.name: get-current-user-details
tools.description: Gets the current user's details including name, phone number, email address, nationality, country living.

tools.name: add-new-contact
tools.description: Adds a new contact to the contacts app.

first_name.description: First name of the contact, required.

last_name.description: Last name of the contact, required.

gender.description: Gender of the contact (Male, Female, Other, Unknown), optional default is Unknown.

city_living.description: City where the contact is living, optional.

country.description: Country where the contact is living, optional.

status.description: Status of the contact (Student, Employed, Unemployed, Retired, Unknown), optional default is Unknown.

phone.description: Phone number of the contact, optional.

email.description: Email address of the contact, optional.

tools.name: edit-contact
tools.description: Edits specific fields of a contact by contact_id.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to edit.

updates.description: JSON dictionary of fields to update. Valid fields: first_name, last_name, gender (Male/Female/Other/Unknown), age (1-100), nationality, city_living, country, status (Student/Employed/Unemployed/Retired/Unknown), job, description, phone, email, address.

tools.name: delete-contact
tools.description: Deletes a specific contact by contact_id.

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to delete.

tools.name: search-contacts
tools.description: Searches for contacts based on a query string. The search looks for partial matches in first name, last name, phone number, and email.

tools.name: list-emails
tools.description: List emails in a folder with pagination.

folder_name.description: Folder name: INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH.

offset.description: Offset of first email to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return.

tools.name: get-email-by-id
tools.description: Get an email by its ID, marking it as read.

tools.name: get-email-by-index
tools.description: Get an email by its index in a folder, marking it as read.

idx.description: Index in the folder (0-based, newest first).

tools.name: send-email
tools.description: Send an email to the specified recipients.

recipients.description: JSON list of recipient email addresses, e.g. '["a@b.com"]'.

attachment_paths.description: JSON list of cloud-drive paths to attach, e.g. '["/Documents/report.pdf"]'.

tools.name: forward-email
tools.description: Forward an email to new recipients.

email_id.description: ID of the email to forward.

recipients.description: JSON list of recipient email addresses.

folder_name.description: Folder containing the email (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

tools.name: download-attachments
tools.description: Download attachments from an email to the local filesystem.

folder_name.description: Folder containing the email (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

path_to_save.description: Cloud-drive directory to save attachments to.

tools.name: reply-to-email
tools.description: Reply to an email.

email_id.description: ID of the email to reply to.

folder_name.description: Folder containing the original email (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

attachment_paths.description: JSON list of cloud-drive paths to attach, e.g. '["/Documents/report.pdf"]'.

tools.name: move-email
tools.description: Move an email from one folder to another.

email_id.description: ID of the email to move.

source_folder_name.description: Source folder name (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

dest_folder_name.description: Destination folder name (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

tools.name: delete-email
tools.description: Delete an email (moves it to TRASH).

email_id.description: ID of the email to delete.

folder_name.description: Folder containing the email (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).

tools.name: search-emails
tools.description: Search emails by query string across sender, recipients, subject, and content.

folder_name.description: Folder to search in (INBOX, SENT, DRAFT, TRASH).
